argument_markdown:
## Interface binding

ATT-0120/CLM-0120-2 through CLM-0120-7 supplies the verified interface. It defines an atlas-independent reduced closed substack Y of X=M_{6,6}, the open U_Y=X minus Y, the restriction map r_T:T to W_{26}H^{26}(U_Y;Q)(21), and the named subobject T_Z=ker(r_T). It proves that T_Z is pure of weight -16 and contains every target class supported on a closed subset contained in Y. It does not assert that T_Z is zero, Tate, generated by cycles, or equal to T, and it constructs no map from the cohomology of Z, an atlas, or a smooth model of Y whose image could compute T_Z.

## Consequences of the fresh evidence

REV-0178 confirms ATT-0128/CLM-0128-1 through CLM-0128-6. For an admissible affine peeling of Y, T_Z has a finite filtration whose dimension-n graded contribution is a subquotient of W_{2n-16}H^{2n-16}(S_{(n)};Q)(n). Contributions vanish for n at most 7 by negative degree and for n at least 17 by affine Artin/Andreotti-Frankel vanishing. The contribution at n=8 is a subquotient of H^0(S_{(8)};Q)(8), hence a finite direct sum of Q(8). Semisimplicity splits the filtration noncanonically.

For every n from 9 through 16, however, the degree 2n-16 is at most n, so the affine vanishing argument does not apply. No verified dependency proves that these remaining lowest-weight groups are Tate, proves that their images in T_Z vanish, or replaces them by another computation of the named kernel. Thus ATT-0128's Tate conclusion remains conditional and cannot prove the theorem.

## Disproof audit

A disproof must exhibit a non-Tate subquotient of the actual ATT-0120 kernel T_Z. The abelian-ninefold model does not do so: it is a separate product-model support, no map from its non-Tate class to T_Z is constructed, and no nonzero target image is proved. Moreover, REV-0178 observes that the proper abelian ninefold cannot be a single affine stratum in ATT-0128's peeling construction; an admissible peeling would use an affine open and lower-dimensional complements. Likewise, the non-Tate class found on an atlas has not been shown to lie on Y or to survive nontrivially in T_Z. These examples therefore fail the theorem's explicit disproof interface.

## Conclusion

The verified material proves neither T_Z is a finite direct sum of Q(8) nor that T_Z has a non-Tate subquotient. The remaining dimension-9-through-16 terms are not discharged, and no interface-surviving counterexample is supplied. This artifact therefore records an inconclusive resolution audit rather than manufacturing a proof or disproof.

claims.statement: The verified ATT-0120 interface identifies the assigned target exactly as T_Z=ker(T -> W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6} minus Y;Q)(21)), a pure weight -16 subobject of T, and makes no Tate or vanishing assertion about it.

The REV-0178-confirmed part of ATT-0128 eliminates peeling contributions in dimensions at most 7 and at least 17 and proves the dimension-8 contribution Tate, but it leaves all possible contributions in dimensions 9 through 16 without a proved Tate or vanishing conclusion.

The abelian-ninefold product model is not an interface-surviving disproof: it is not the ATT-0120 support Y, its non-Tate class has no proved nonzero image in T_Z, and its proper ninefold cannot be represented as one affine peeling stratum.
No class supplied by ATT-0128 or REV-0178 is proved both non-Tate and nonzero in the named target T_Z, so the exact disproof criterion is not met.
The supplied verified dependencies do not establish the exact theorem and do not establish its negation through the required target interface.

summary: The exact theorem is not resolved. ATT-0120 defines the named target T_Z as the pure weight -16 kernel of restriction and explicitly supplies no Tate assertion. ATT-0128, as reviewed in REV-0178, proves only an affine-peeling localization: strata of dimensions at most 7 or at least 17 contribute zero, and the dimension-8 contribution is Tate, while possible contributions from dimensions 9 through 16 remain undetermined. REV-0178 also rejects the claimed realization of the abelian-ninefold product model as one affine stratum. No verified source produces a non-Tate class on the actual ATT-0120 support Y with a proved nonzero image in T_Z. Consequently neither the proof criterion nor the disproof criterion is met, and claiming either would be mathematically unsupported.

target_interface_reference.atlas_invariance: Inherited from ATT-0120/CLM-0120-6: Y and the datum (K_Z,T_Z,phi) depend only on the pair (M_{6,6},Y) and are independent of the chosen presentation or atlas.
target_interface_reference.coverage: Inherited from ATT-0120/CLM-0120-5: every target class supported on a closed subset contained in Y lies in T_Z, while support-exhaustion T_Z=T is not asserted.
target_interface_reference.degree_weight_twist: T and T_Z have Borel-Moore degree 16 and weight -16; equivalently they occur in ordinary degree 26 with Poincare twist (21). The requested Tate type is Q(8).
target_interface_reference.survival_or_tate_argument: No unconditional survival-or-Tate conclusion is available. The verified peeling filtration applies to this exact kernel T_Z and proves vanishing only for stratum dimensions n at most 7 or n at least 17, with the n=8 contribution Tate. Contributions for 9 <= n <= 16 remain undetermined. No verified class in those dimensions is both non-Tate and proved to have nonzero image in T_Z. Therefore the interface supplies neither a proof nor a disproof of the assigned theorem.
target_interface_reference.target_map_use: The only target map used is phi:T_Z into T, the inclusion of the kernel constructed from r_T in ATT-0120/CLM-0120-3 and CLM-0120-4. No Gysin map, source-to-target pushforward, cycle-class map, or unproved map from Z, an atlas, a family base, or a model of Y is used.
target_interface_reference.target_subquotient: T_Z:=K_Z=ker(r_T), where r_T:T=W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q)=W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21) -> W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6} minus Y;Q)(21) is restriction and Y is the atlas-independent reduced closed substack of ATT-0120/CLM-0120-2.

theorem_scope.resolution: No complete proof and no interface-surviving disproof is obtained from the supplied verified dependencies.

theorem_statement: Let T_Z be the canonical mixed-Hodge subquotient of T:=W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) supplied by a verified C66-SUPPORT-INTERFACE datum. Prove T_Z is a finite direct sum of Q(8). A disproof must exhibit a non-Tate subquotient of this named T_Z through the verified target interface; non-Tate cohomology of an arbitrary family base, atlas, product model, standalone Z, or a source class whose target image is not proved nonzero is not a disproof. This theorem does not itself assemble the complementary target terms.
